agent: CREATE TABLE "code_sessions" (session_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, user_id VARCHAR, session_data JSON, metadata JSON, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, updated_at BIGINT, session_state JSON, PRIMARY KEY (session_id));

CREATE TABLE "code_sessions_log_messages" (run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "code_sessions_log_runs"(run_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, message_id TEXT NOT NULL, ord INTEGER NOT NULL, folded_by INTEGER, data TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (run_id, message_id));
CREATE TABLE "code_sessions_log_meta" (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), version INTEGER NOT NULL, next_seq INTEGER NOT NULL, owner_kind TEXT, owner_id TEXT);
CREATE TABLE "code_sessions_log_removed" (run_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "code_sessions"(session_id) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE "code_sessions_log_runs" (run_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "code_sessions"(session_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, parent_run_id TEXT, kind TEXT NOT NULL, scope_key TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, seq INTEGER NOT NULL, folded_by INTEGER, has_tools INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, metadata TEXT, record TEXT NOT NULL, requirements TEXT);

CREATE TABLE "code_sessions_log_summaries" (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "code_sessions"(session_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, scope_key TEXT NOT NULL, through INTEGER NOT NULL, legacy INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, fold_run_id TEXT, summary TEXT, event_ids TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', seen_event_ids TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', fold_event_ids TEXT, fold_seen_event_ids TEXT);
CREATE TABLE "code_sessions_log_tools" (run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "code_sessions_log_runs"(run_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, ord INTEGER NOT NULL, data TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (run_id, ord));

CREATE TABLE "code_sessions_usage" (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "code_sessions"(session_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, run_id TEXT, usage_data TEXT, UNIQUE(session_id, run_id));
